description: Ring membership for agent canary rollout (initiative #495, issues #500/#501). The promotion automation (scripts/canary-rollout.sh) reads this as the single source of truth. `next` is host-relative: it resolves to the repo that HOSTS the reusable; `ring0` covers the other org-infra repo (the host already sits in `next`).

member_tokens.$host: the agent's host repo (the repo that owns the reusable)
member_tokens.$org_infra: org_infra_repos minus the host (the host is already in `next`)
member_tokens.*: every other consumer not named in an earlier ring

gate._standard: petry-projects/.github#548 — graduated dwell/sample gate over a per-candidate cumulative window. These are registry-configurable per-transition knobs; the values below are the #548 defaults.

benign_failure_classes.reason: #864 — a Dev-Lead run dispatched in a Dependabot context cannot read repo secrets; version-independent benign failure, not a candidate regression.
fix-review git push denied by branch protection / missing write scope; version-independent benign failure, not a candidate regression.

gate._benign_note: benign_failure_classes (#1025 P2): per-reusable allowlist matched against a failed run's workflow name (`workflow` ERE) + failed-step signature (`step` ERE, matched via `gh run view`). Matches are excluded from cum_fail — but ONLY when the candidate's reusable is byte-identical to the prior channel (differs=0), so the allowlist can never mask a candidate-introduced regression. `control.allow_pre_existing`, or `promote --allow-pre-existing`, advances a BLOCKED+PRE_EXISTING frontier (never REGRESSION).

gate._topology_note: #482 cross-repo reusable: the reusable lives in the host petry-projects/.github, but the rollout is canaried in .github-private (order 0, the caller-stub/automation repo) BEFORE the host (ring0). waive_sample_if_no_caller lets an agent with no .github-private caller (e.g. dependabot-rebase) soak from ring0 without a fresh next-tier sample.
